mapper.select: SELECT POST_ID, WRITER, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEW_COUNT, CREATE_AT, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_AT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS FORMATTED_CREATE_AT, PLACE, TRANSPORT_COST, FOOD_COST, OTHER_COST FROM POST WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND IS_BLOCK = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POST ( WRITER, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEW_COUNT, CREATE_AT, IS_BLOCK, PLACE, TRANSPORT_COST, FOOD_COST, OTHER_COST ) VALUES ( #{writer}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, now(), FALSE, #{place}, #{transportCost}, #{foodCost}, #{otherCost} )
mapper.select:
SELECT P.POST_ID, P.WRITER, P.TITLE, P.CONTENT, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATE_AT, ( SELECT IU.UPLOAD_PATH FROM POST_UPLOAD PU JOIN IMAGE_UPLOAD IU ON IU.UPLOAD_ID = PU.UPLOAD_ID WHERE PU.POST_ID = P.POST_ID ORDER BY IU.IMAGE_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS THUMBNAIL_PATH, DATE_FORMAT(P.CREATE_AT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS FORMATTED_CREATE_AT FROM POST P WHERE P.IS_BLOCK = FALSE
AND ( P.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY
P.POST_ID ASC
P.POST_ID DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT IU.UPLOAD_ID, PU.POST_ID, IU.ORIGIN_NAME, IU.UPLOAD_PATH, IU.IMAGE_ORDER FROM POST_UPLOAD PU JOIN IMAGE_UPLOAD IU ON IU.UPLOAD_ID = PU.UPLOAD_ID WHERE PU.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY IU.IMAGE_ORDER ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE POST SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, PLACE = #{place}, TRANSPORT_COST = #{transportCost}, FOOD_COST = #{foodCost}, OTHER_COST = #{otherCost} WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
